hero.eyebrow: Matt Greisamer — UX Design & Research Leader
hero.headline: Research-led design leadership for complex B2B products.
hero.intro: I build and lead teams whose research changes what gets built, not only how it looks. 10+ years in UX, 7+ managing design and research teams.

quote.label: Team standard
quote.text: Understand the user better than anyone, the product nearly as well as the PMs, and the technology nearly as well as the developers.

method.text: Interviews, advisory boards and field research before a pixel moves.
Personas, journey maps and a shared problem statement with Product.
Design systems so teams spend time on problems, not pixels.
Servant leadership: designers and researchers become product leaders.

contact.headline: Got a hard problem and a team to build?
